title: Fractional Risk Analysis of Stochastic Systems with Jumps and Memory
summary: Accurate risk assessment is essential for safety-critical autonomous and control systems under uncertainty. In many real-world settings, stochastic dynamics exhibit asymmetric jumps and long-range memory, making long-term risk probabilities difficult to estimate across varying system dynamics, initial conditions, and time horizons.
